blob: effect of hot isostatic pressing temperature on microcrack, microstructure and mechanical properties of gh3536 nickel-based superalloy fabricated by selective laser melting 摘要： 利用激光选区熔化(selective laser melting, slm)技术制备了gh3536镍基高温合金，研究了不同热等静压(hot isostatic pressing, hip)温度对slm成形gh3536合金裂纹和组织性能的影响。利用x射线衍射仪(x-ray diffraction, xrd)、扫描电镜(scanning electron microscope, sem)、电子背散射衍射(electron backscatter diffraction, ebsd)、电子探针显微分析仪(electron probe microanalyzer, epma)等方式表征了gh3536相组成和组织演变，利用高温持久性能试验机测试合金室温和高温拉伸性能。结果表明：经hip后，slm成形gh3536合金相组成保持不变，均为γ相，但晶格常数降低，且随着hip温度的升高而降低。slm态合金中存在10～100 μm的微裂纹和气孔缺陷，微裂纹主要存在于熔池边界。经hip后，合金中微裂纹完全消除，但仍存在少量孔洞。gh3536合金经高温高压处理后，晶粒尺寸增大，抗拉强度有所降低。其中s 该论文研究镍基高温合金的slm工艺与力学性能，不涉及生物医用植入物或骨整合。 this paper focuses on high-temperature nickel superalloy for industrial applications; it lacks any biomedical context, porous structure design, stress shielding analysis, fatigue testing, or osseointegration assessment. 研究热等静压温度对slm成形镍基高温合金裂纹和性能的影响。 通过xrd、sem、ebsd、epma表征组织，并测试室温和高温拉伸性能。 hip消除微裂纹但降低强度，提高塑性。 实验测试与显微表征结合。 slm hot isostatic pressing nickel-based superalloy microstructure mechanical properties slm 激光选区熔化 hot isostatic pressing 热等静压 nickel-based superalloy 镍基高温合金 microcrack 微裂纹 tensile properties 拉伸性能 ductility 塑性 microstructure 显微组织 ebsd 电子背散射衍射 epma 电子探针显微分析 yin xie, qing teng, shanshan sun, tan cheng, bai jie journal of mechanical engineering 1. state key laboratory of material processing and die & mould technology, huazhong university of science and technology, wuhan 430074;2. beijing power machinery institute, beijing 100074

title: Design and Mechanical Properties Analysis of Additive Manufactured Porous Structures by Selective Laser Melting
authors: SHI Yan, ZHANG Heng
blob: design and mechanical properties analysis of additive manufactured porous structures by selective laser melting 摘要： 面向选区激光熔化(selective laser melting,slm)增材制造轻质高强多孔结构的需求，采用拓扑优化设计方法，通过调节孔隙率和载荷施加位置对正六面体进行结构优化，得到了点、线和面拓扑多孔结构，并利用slm技术制备了alsi10mg多孔结构试样。通过压缩试验测试多孔结构的力学性能，采用有限元法分析多孔结构的破坏机理。结果表明，随着孔隙率的增加，点、线和面拓扑多孔结构的屈服强度和弹性模量逐渐降低。有限元分析表明，面拓扑多孔结构的应力分布是最均匀，在相同压缩位移下，面拓扑多孔结构的力学性能最佳，线拓扑多孔结构次之，点拓扑多孔结构的力学性能最差。该结果证明了面拓扑优化是三种优化方式中最理想的一种。采用经典的gibson-ashby模型建立了力学性能与几何参数之间的数学关系，可用来预测三种多孔结构的孔隙率与力学性能关系，为多孔结构的应用提供了理论依据。 该论文通过slm制备多孔结构并进行力学测试，方法可迁移至生物医用植入体的刚度匹配设计，但缺乏生物力学背景和疲劳测试。 does not address biomedical context such as stress shielding, fatigue, or osseointegration, and uses alsi10mg rather than biomedical-grade ti alloy. 面向slm轻质高强多孔结构需求，通过拓扑优化设计并制备alsi10mg多孔结构，研究其力学性能。 采用拓扑优化设计点、线、面多孔结构，slm制备，压缩试验与有限元分析相结合。 面拓扑多孔结构应力分布最均匀，力学性能最佳；gibson-ashby模型可预测孔隙率-性能关系。 压缩试验和有限元分析验证了力学性能与破坏机理。 topology optimization selective laser melting porous structures alsi10mg compression testing gibson-ashby model finite element analysis topology optimization 拓扑优化 selective laser melting 选区激光熔化 porous structure 多孔结构 alsi10mg alsi10mg合金 compression test 压缩试验 gibson-ashby model gibson-ashby模型 finite element analysis 有限元分析 yield strength 屈服强度 elastic modulus 弹性模量 shi yan, zhang heng journal of mechanical engineering 1. school of electromechanical engineering, changchun university of science and technology, changchun 130022;2. national base of international science and technology cooperation for optics, changchun university of science and technology, changchun 130022

authors: MAO Yangkun, Xianyin Duan, Lin Xin et al.
blob: melt pool and spatter monitoring in selective laser melting forming process based on target detection 摘要： 在选区激光熔融成形过程中,飞溅与熔池包含了能够体现加工质量的重要特征信息,从成形过程采集到的熔池图像中,获得这些信息,实现选区激光熔融的过程监测是近年来研究的重点之一。为了更加精确且有效地从图像中提取熔池和飞溅的信息,提出了一种基于yolov5目标检测模型,实现了对成形过程图像中飞溅与熔池的实时定位与捕获。首先,以yolov5s目标检测网络为基础,调整骨干网络的深度与宽度,修改检测头的数量。之后,引入自校正卷积与cbam注意力机制模块,设计了新的特征整合结构,通过上述步骤,提升了网络的检测性能。将工业相机采集到的图像制作为目标检测数据集,进行模型的训练与测试,结果表明该网络能够从原始图像中对飞溅与熔池目标进行准确的定位,在具有良好的检测精度的同时,网络模型的参数量极少,更加符合工业应用的需求。网络的检测精度map@0.5:0.95达到了0.466,为基于图像的选区激光熔融过程监测提供了一种新的方法。 该论文研究选区激光熔融过程中的熔池与飞溅监测，未涉及生物医学植入物多孔结构、应力遮挡或力学性能测试。 this paper focuses on process monitoring of slm using object detection, with no connection to biomedical implants, porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue testing, or surface characterization for osseointegration. 实现选区激光熔融过程熔池与飞溅的实时监测 基于改进yolov5目标检测模型定位熔池与飞溅 模型准确检测熔池与飞溅，map@0.5:0.95达0.466，参数量少 工业相机采集图像制作数据集进行训练测试 slm process monitoring melt pool spatter yolov5 target detection selective laser melting 选区激光熔融 melt pool 熔池 spatter 飞溅 process monitoring 过程监测 yolov5 yolov5目标检测 cbam attention cbam注意力机制 mao yangkun, xianyin duan, lin xin, f j, zhu kunpeng journal of mechanical engineering 1. institute of intelligent machines, hefei institutes of physical science, chinese academy of sciences, hefei 230031;2. university of science and technology of china, hefei 230026;3. key laboratory of metallurgical equipment and control technology, ministry of education, wuhan university of science and technology, wuhan 430081;4. national university of singapore(suzhou) research institute, suzhou 215123;5. changzhou institute of advanced manufacturing technology, changzhou 213164

blob: advances in 3d bioprinting: additive manufacturing of living cells from animal, plant, and microbe 摘要： 生物有机体的仿生制造对人类探索和运用生命机制具有重要意义。生物3d打印基于计算机三维模型，精准控制活细胞、生物材料、生化因子等物质的空间位置，可以模拟人体的组织结构，制造具有复杂异质性的仿生生物组织，并应用于基础研究和临床转化。近年来，生物3d打印技术还拓展到了植物细胞培养以及微生物合成发酵等领域，展现出巨大的应用潜力。本文将对生物3d打印技术的基本原理及最新进展进行介绍，并从动物、植物和微生物细胞打印三方面综述应用现状及挑战，以期对广义生物3d打印的技术发展及应用趋势进行全面梳理。 该论文为生物3d打印的综述，未涉及ai集成，与ai驱动生物打印方向关联较弱。 this paper is a general review of 3d bioprinting technologies without any integration of ai/ml, experimental validation, or autonomous decision-making in the bioprinting workflow. 综述生物3d打印在动物、植物和微生物细胞方面的应用现状与挑战。 基于文献调研，梳理生物3d打印的原理、技术进展及多领域应用。 总结了生物3d打印在组织工程、植物细胞培养和微生物发酵中的潜力与瓶颈。 无实验验证，纯综述性质。 review bioprinting living cells 3d bioprinting 3d生物打印 additive manufacturing 增材制造 living cells 活细胞 tissue engineering 组织工程 biomaterials 生物材料 plant cell culture 植物细胞培养 microbial synthesis 微生物合成 li peixi, zhou dezhi, yang changming, rao weiyi, feng lin journal of mechanical engineering 1. department of mechanical engineering, tsinghua university, beijing 100084;2. weiyang college, tsinghua university, beijing 100084;3. tanwei college, tsinghua university, beijing 100084

title: Total Hip Arthroplasty and Locomotive Syndrome
authors: Naofumi Taniguchi
venue: The Japanese Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
blob: total hip arthroplasty and locomotive syndrome わが国は超高齢社会を迎えている．健康寿命の延伸が課題となる時代背景を踏まえ，日本整形外科学会からロコモティブシンドロームが提唱された．ロコモティブシンドロームは移動能力が低下した状態を示す概念である．人工股関節全置換術（tha）を受ける患者はロコモティブシンドロームに陥っている．tha術後に股関節機能は向上するが，ロコモティブシンドロームを克服できない患者も多い．thaを受ける患者の多くには術前から股関節可動域制限や周囲筋萎縮があり，術後も残存して歩行能力の回復を妨げる．歩行能力の回復を促進するためにもロコモティブシンドロームを認識して，術後もロコトレなどのリハビリテーション治療を継続することが望ましい． 这篇文章与用户研究方向无关，仅讨论tha术后康复和运动综合症，不涉及任何生物力学或有限元分析。 this paper does not contain any biomechanical modeling, finite element analysis, stress shielding quantification, micromotion assessment, or implant mechanics; it is purely a clinical rehabilitation review. 探讨tha患者术后运动综合症与康复治疗。 综述tha术后功能恢复与运动综合症的关系。 指出术后仍需康复训练以克服运动综合症。 无实验或仿真验证。 total hip arthroplasty locomotive syndrome rehabilitation total hip arthroplasty 人工股関節全置換術 locomotive syndrome ロコモティブシンドローム rehabilitation リハビリテーション muscle atrophy 筋萎縮 range of motion 関節可動域 naofumi taniguchi the japanese journal of rehabilitation medicine 山梨大学附属病院リハビリテーション科

title: Recent Post-treatment for Total Hip Arthroplasty
authors: Takeshi Okayasu
venue: The Japanese Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
blob: recent post-treatment for total hip arthroplasty 医療の進歩により人工股関節置換術（tha）後の入院期間は短縮化傾向にある．これに伴い，近年理学療法士の介入内容も変化しており，特に前方系アプローチの普及による脱臼回避動作指導の変化や治療介入頻度の減少が顕著である．このような状況の中で，tha術後リハビリテーション治療の必要性の有無が議論されることもあるが，深部静脈血栓症や肺塞栓などの術後合併症対策や自宅退院後の自主トレーニングに対する理解獲得などにとって，術後リハビリテーション治療の実施は効果を示すと思われる．理学療法士は限られた治療介入時間や回数の中で効率的にプログラムを立案し，自主トレーニングとして日常生活にリハビリテーション治療を汎化させることを念頭に置くことが重要である． 该论文讨论tha术后康复治疗，未涉及髋关节假体生物力学分析。 this paper focuses on clinical rehabilitation after tha and does not contain any biomechanical modeling of the hip implant, stress shielding analysis, micromotion quantification, or finite element methods. 探讨tha术后康复治疗的必要性与方法变化 综述近年tha术后康复治疗的变化与挑战 认为康复治疗仍有效，需优化干预方案 文献回顾，无实验验证 tha rehabilitation clinical review total hip arthroplasty 全髋关节置换术 rehabilitation 康复治疗 physical therapy 物理疗法 dislocation prevention 脱臼预防 deep vein thrombosis 深静脉血栓 takeshi okayasu the japanese journal of rehabilitation medicine 東京医科歯科大学病院リハビリテーション部

title: Prophylaxis and Treatment of Venous Thromboembolism in Patients Undergoing Total Hip Arthroplasty
authors: Taro Tezuka, Yutaka Inaba
venue: The Japanese Journal of Rehabilitation Medicine
blob: prophylaxis and treatment of venous thromboembolism in patients undergoing total hip arthroplasty 人工股関節全置換術（tha）後の合併症のうち，症候性肺血栓塞栓症（pte）はときに致死的な合併症となる．必ずしも生死にかかわらない疾患にthaを行うことで致死的な合併症のリスクを低確率とはいえ，患者に負わせることは問題である．本邦では2017年に日本整形外科学会から症候性静脈血栓塞栓症（vte）のガイドラインが刊行され，また2020年には整形外科手術の周術期におけるinternational consensus meetingが開催され，整形外科領域におけるvte予防は世界的にますます重要視されている．本稿ではtha周術期におけるvteの予防および発症時の対応について解説する． 该论文仅讨论tha术后静脉血栓栓塞的预防和治疗，不涉及任何生物力学或植入物机械性能分析。 this paper does not quantify stress shielding, micromotion, or bone-implant interface mechanics; it is purely clinical and does not include fea or biomechanical modeling. 讨论tha术后致死性肺血栓栓塞症的预防和治疗必要性 基于2017年日本骨科指南和2020年国际共识会议综述现有证据 强调vte预防在tha围术期的重要性并给出处理建议 无生物力学验证，仅为临床建议综述 clinical tha vte prophylaxis total hip arthroplasty 人工股関節全置換術 venous thromboembolism 静脈血栓栓塞症 pulmonary embolism 肺血栓栓塞症 prophylaxis 予防 perioperative management 周術期管理 taro tezuka, yutaka inaba the japanese journal of rehabilitation medicine 横浜市立大学医学部整形外科学教室

blob: containing a spread through sequential learning: to exploit or to explore? the spread of an undesirable contact process, such as an infectious disease (e.g. covid-19), is contained through testing and isolation of infected nodes. the temporal and spatial evolution of the process (along with containment through isolation) render such detection as fundamentally different from active search detection strategies. in this work, through an active learning approach, we design testing and isolation strategies to contain the spread and minimize the cumulative infections under a 该论文涉及传染病传播的主动学习策略，与有限元代理建模或植入物设计完全无关。 this paper is about epidemic containment and active learning for disease spread, with no fea, surrogate modeling, or biomechanics context. 研究在疫情传播中如何通过主动学习策略进行测试和隔离以最小化累计感染。 使用消息传递框架估计感染概率，并设计基于奖励的启发式方法及概率探索策略。 证明了贪婪选择节点测试的最优性，并展示了探索与利用的权衡。 在合成和真实网络数据上进行模拟验证。 active learning sequential testing epidemic containment network active learning 主动学习 sequential testing 序贯测试 epidemic containment 疫情遏制 exploration vs exploitation 探索与利用 message passing 消息传递 greedy algorithm 贪婪算法 xingran chen, hesam nikpey, jungyeol kim, saswati sarkar, shirin saeedi-bidokhti arxiv preprint

title: In-situ ionic crosslinking of 3D bioprinted cell-hydrogel constructs for mechanical reinforcement and improved cell growth.

blob: a case of anesthetic management for total hip arthroplasty after heart transplantation 特発性拡張型心筋症で心臓移植を受け，移植後のステロイドパルス療法が原因の大腿骨頭壊死に対する人工股関節置換術の全身麻酔管理を経験した．移植心は自律神経支配を受けず心拍数はほぼ一定だが，血圧低下や静脈還流減少時に応じた心拍数減少が予想される．術中は必要時に心拍数を直接的にコントロールする必要があるため，本症例では急な循環動態変動時の心拍数調節対策としてカテコラミン投与と経皮的ペーシング装置の準備を行った．術中の経過としては導入時の血圧低下に伴い心拍数が80回/分から60回/分に減少し，そのまま変動なく経過した．一時的にフェニレフリンを投与する場面があったものの，大きな循環動態変動はなかった． 该论文仅涉及心脏移植后全髋关节置换术的麻醉管理，未包含任何与髋关节植入物力学性能或应力遮挡相关的内容。 this paper is a clinical case report on anesthetic management for total hip arthroplasty after heart transplantation; it contains no biomechanical analysis, no stress shielding quantification, no micromotion modeling, and no finite element simulations relevant to hip implant mechanics. 报道心脏移植后股骨头坏死患者全髋置换的麻醉管理经验 采用全身麻醉，准备儿茶酚胺和经皮起搏装置应对循环波动 术中循环稳定，仅需一次苯肾上腺素干预 单病例报告，无对照或重复 anesthesia total hip arthroplasty heart transplantation case report total hip arthroplasty 全髋关节置换术 heart transplantation 心脏移植 anesthetic management 麻醉管理 hemodynamic stability 血流动力学稳定性 femoral head necrosis 股骨头坏死 catecholamine 儿茶酚胺 transcutaneous pacing 经皮起搏 kasumi kimoto, toshihiro kikuchi, masahiko odo, eizoh gondoh the journal of japan society for clinical anesthesia department of anesthesiology and pain medicine, juntendo university nerima hospital

title: Functional Causal Bayesian Optimization
authors: Limor Gultchin, Virginia Aglietti, Alexis Bellot et al.
blob: functional causal bayesian optimization we propose functional causal bayesian optimization (fcbo), a method for finding interventions that optimize a target variable in a known causal graph. fcbo extends the cbo family of methods to enable functional interventions, which set a variable to be a deterministic function of other variables in the graph. fcbo models the unknown objectives with gaussian processes whose inputs are defined in a reproducing kernel hilbert space, thus allowing to compute distances among vector-valued functions.  该方法提出了功能因果贝叶斯优化框架，利用高斯过程优化因果图中的功能干预，但其未涉及有限元分析或生物力学设计的具体应用，需额外适配。 no fea simulation, no constraint handling, no biomedical or implant context, and no experimental validation in the target domain. 已知因果图中通过功能干预优化目标变量，但现有方法无法处理函数形式的干预。 提出fcbo框架，在再生核希尔伯特空间中用高斯过程建模未知目标函数，并通过期望改进获取函数顺序选择干预函数。 在合成和真实因果图中，fcbo相比基线方法取得了更好的目标优化效果。 通过合成数据和真实因果图上的数值实验进行验证。 causal bayesian optimization gaussian process functional interventions surrogate model uncertainty quantification causal bayesian optimization 因果贝叶斯优化 functional intervention 功能干预 gaussian process 高斯过程 reproducing kernel hilbert space 再生核希尔伯特空间 expected improvement 期望改进 causal graph 因果图 surrogate model 代理模型 uncertainty quantification 不确定性量化 limor gultchin, virginia aglietti, alexis bellot, silvia chiappa arxiv preprint

blob: combining microfluidics and coaxial 3d-bioprinting for the manufacturing of diabetic wound healing dressings diabetic foot ulcers (dfus) are a crucial complication of diabetes, as in a diabetic wound, each step of the physiological healing process is affected. this entails a more easily infectable wound, and delayed tissue regeneration due to the inflammation that occurs, leading to a drastic decrease in the overall patient's quality of life. as a strategy to manage dfus, skin alternatives and wound dressings are currently receiving a lot of attention as they keep the wound environment "under control", 该论文涉及3d生物打印和微流体技术用于伤口敷料，但完全未包含ai/机器学习方法，因此与ai生物打印方向无直接关联。 this paper does not incorporate any ai, machine learning, or intelligent decision-making into the bioprinting workflow; it is purely a materials and fabrication study. 针对糖尿病足溃疡愈合延迟的问题，开发结合微流控与同轴3d生物打印的伤口敷料。 利用微流控制备百里香油脂质体，并将其包裹在纳米复合水凝胶中作为同轴打印的芯层，壳层为海藻酸钠/纤维素纳米晶水凝胶。 实现双重释放：壳层前24小时快速释放，芯层脂质体持续释放10天，敷料对革兰氏阳性菌和阴性菌均有抗菌活性。 通过共聚焦显微镜验证脂质体在打印后仍存在，并通过抑菌圈试验验证抗菌效果。 bioprinting microfluidics wound dressing no-ai coaxial 3d bioprinting 同轴3d生物打印 microfluidics 微流控技术 liposomes 脂质体 wound dressing 伤口敷料 diabetic foot ulcer 糖尿病足溃疡 thyme oil 百里香油 hydrogel 水凝胶 sustained release 缓释 costanza fratini, edward weaver, sofia moroni, robyn irwin, yahya h. dallal bashi biomaterials advances school of pharmacy, queen's university belfast, 97 lisburn road, belfast bt9 7bl, united kingdom; department of biomolecular sciences, university of urbino carlo bo, 61029 urbino, italy

blob: on the sublinear regret of gp-ucb in the kernelized bandit problem, a learner aims to sequentially compute the optimum of a function lying in a reproducing kernel hilbert space given only noisy evaluations at sequentially chosen points. in particular, the learner aims to minimize regret, which is a measure of the suboptimality of the choices made. arguably the most popular algorithm is the gaussian process upper confidence bound (gp-ucb) algorithm, which involves acting based on a simple linear estimator of the unknown function. 该论文仅对gp-ucb算法进行理论遗憾分析，与fea替代建模或植入物设计优化无直接关系。 this paper does not address surrogate modeling for fea, does not handle design optimization constraints, does not include uncertainty quantification for engineering applications, and is not transferable to implant/biomechanics design. 解决gp-ucb算法在常用核（如matérn）下遗憾界非次线性的问题。 通过正则化核岭估计器与分离hilbert空间浓度分析改进遗憾界。 证明gp-ucb达到近乎最优的遗憾率，为matérn核提供次线性界。 纯理论证明，无实验验证。 gp-ucb kernelized bandit regret analysis matérn kernel theoretical machine learning gp-ucb 高斯过程上置信界 kernelized bandit 核化赌博机 regret 遗憾 matérn kernel matérn核 reproducing kernel hilbert space 再生核希尔伯特空间 concentration inequality 集中不等式 sublinear regret 次线性遗憾 justin whitehouse, zhiwei steven wu, aaditya ramdas arxiv preprint

blob: soft‐magnetic behavior of fe‐based nanocrystalline alloys produced using laser powder bed fusion herein, an extensive experimental study is presented on the influence of the major process parameters of the laser powder bed fusion (lpbf) technique on the bulk density and soft‐magnetic properties of fe‐based bulk metallic glasses (bmgs). for this purpose, 81 samples are manufactured using the combinations of different process parameters, that is, layer thickness ( t : 50–70 μm), laser power ( p : 70–130 w), laser scan speed ( v : 900–1100 mm s −1 ), and hatch spacing ( h : 20–40 μm). high bul 该论文研究激光粉末床熔融制备的铁基纳米晶软磁合金的磁性能，与生物医学植入物的力学性能、多孔结构或骨整合无关。 this paper focuses on soft magnetic behavior of fe-based alloys for non-biomedical applications, with no mention of porous structures, stress shielding, fatigue, surface roughness, or osseointegration relevant to biomedical implants. 研究lpbf工艺参数对铁基非晶合金密度和软磁性能的影响。 制备81个样品，变化层厚、激光功率、扫描速度和间距，进行密度和磁性能测试。 低功率和速度结合小间距和层厚获得高密度（≥99%），特定间距和速度获得高饱和磁化强度。 通过热模拟解释微观结构演变，实验验证工艺参数影响。 laser powder bed fusion soft-magnetic fe-based nanocrystalline process parameters magnetic properties laser powder bed fusion 激光粉末床熔融 soft-magnetic properties 软磁性能 fe-based nanocrystalline alloys 铁基纳米晶合金 bulk metallic glasses 块体金属玻璃 process parameters 工艺参数 saturation magnetization 饱和磁化强度 melt pool 熔池 heat-affected zone 热影响区 merve g. özden, felicity freeman, nicola morley advanced engineering materials department of material science and engineering university of sheffield  sheffield s1 3jd uk

title: Online Student-$t$ Processes with an Overall-local Scale Structure for Modelling Non-stationary Data

blob: online student-$t$ processes with an overall-local scale structure for modelling non-stationary data time-dependent data often exhibit characteristics, such as non-stationarity and heavy-tailed errors, that would be inappropriate to model with the typical assumptions used in popular models. thus, more flexible approaches are required to be able to accommodate such issues. to this end, we propose a bayesian mixture of student-$t$ processes with an overall-local scale structure for the covariance. moreover, we use a sequential monte carlo (smc) sampler in order to perform online inference as data 这篇论文提出了一种在线学生-t过程混合模型，用于非平稳时间序列数据，与有限元代理建模或生物力学设计无直接关联。 this paper does not address expensive simulation sampling efficiency, does not handle constraints, and is not applied to fea or biomechanical design; it focuses on time series modeling. 建模非平稳和重尾时间序列数据 提出具有整体-局部尺度结构的贝叶斯学生-t过程混合模型，使用序贯蒙特卡洛进行在线推断 在真实数据集上优于典型高斯过程模型 在多个真实世界时间序列数据集上验证 student-t process bayesian nonparametrics sequential monte carlo non-stationary time series heavy-tailed errors student-t process 学生-t过程 gaussian process 高斯过程 sequential monte carlo 序贯蒙特卡洛 non-stationary time series 非平稳时间序列 heavy-tailed errors 重尾误差 taole sha, michael minyi zhang arxiv preprint

title: A Unified Framework for the Error Analysis of Physics-Informed Neural Networks
authors: Marius Zeinhofer, Rami Masri, Kent-André Mardal

authors: Simon Dirmeier, Ye Hong, Yanan Xin et al.
